reviews.text: Karla is incredibly kind to dogs. She teaches them how to play and how to get along. I've learned so much from her. She's always attentive, dedicated, and very loving. She's one of those special people who has a unique connection with dogs. I highly recommend her.
She's incredibly attentive to the dogs, always playing with them, and so loving.

Carachata is excellent at taking care of the dogs. She protects them and has helped many dogs bond into a true pack. She's patient with every dog, even my mischievous Huskies. She gets the dogs to play, learn, walk, and run, and she's attentive to their needs. My dogs love her very much and are very happy with her.

Highly recommended!
It takes care of my Roma every time I travel.
I loved Carla's attention!!! My Jochito was very pampered!! I highly recommend it.
She's amazing, very careful with my dog ​​and, above all, always respectful of the environment. Highly recommended!

My dog ​​Chancho passed away a month ago, and Carla was his guardian angel. For the last two years of his life, she was always looking after him, taking care of him, walking him, and spoiling him just like I did. When I went on trips, I had the peace of mind of knowing he was in the best hands. I'll always remember how excited Chancho would get every morning when he saw her arrive so they could go for walks together with her and his pack. Without a doubt, Carla is the best person you could ever entrust your fur baby to. I did it, and I would do it a thousand times over. Thank you always!
She's an excellent person and treats our furry babies incredibly well. 100% recommended!

Carla has been the best thing that could have happened to us!
She takes care of my dog ​​Eugenia with incredible love and attention. She's super attentive and truly provides personalized service. She knows each dog perfectly and, above all, their needs.
Something I value immensely is that she always keeps me updated on everything Euge did on her walks. She tells me how it went, who she spent time with, and how she felt. That gives me enormous peace of mind.
Eugenia loves her. She gets genuinely excited every time she sees her, and that says it all for me. 🤍🤩
